title: Concept: PBKDF2 with low iteration count (python) — review required
description: In python, pbkdf2_hmacs*([^)]*,s*[0-9]{1,4}b sets PBKDF2's work factor. Iteration counts that were fine a decade ago now fall to GPUs in hours. Current guidance (210,000+ iterations) restores the cost asymmetry. The remedy is raising the count.
applicability: python password hashing; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cheap offline cracking of stolen hashes; MEDIUM severity.
